scores.claim_text: Land Systems delivers US Army Enduring Indirect Fire Protection Capability (IFPC).
supports: usaspending: Leidos has $9.4B / 14,394 DoD awards historically; keyword filter not applied in connector so we cannot pin specifically to IFPC
scores.interpretation: IFPC (PE 0604601A, Army procurement) is outside the 410-program J-Book corpus that we hold (corpus skews to DARPA / SDA / Space Force / OSD / AF RDT&E). Heuristic 7 applies: NOT_FOUND is UNVERIFIABLE, not negative. Filing is vague (mentions IFPC as one of three example programs in a list); no revenue % is attributed to it, so materiality is low even if the program were stressed.

scores.claim_text: Land Systems develops Army Long Range Persistent Surveillance (LRPS) radar capability.
scores.interpretation: Army ground-radar PE outside our corpus scope; UNVERIFIABLE per Heuristic 7. Claim is qualitative (no revenue or backlog attribution) so low narrative load even if program were shrinking.

scores.claim_text: Aerospace Systems supplies hypersonic boost-glide structures + hypersonic test services.
scores.interpretation: Army LRHW (Dark Eagle) and Navy CPS are large procurement/RDT&E lines not in this slice of the corpus. Dynetics is a major Leidos subsidiary in Huntsville (consistent with the 801K-sqft footprint claim C10). UNVERIFIABLE rather than negative. Note for analyst: hypersonics is a publicly disclosed Pentagon priority through FY26 budget — base-rate prior is growing, not shrinking.

scores.claim_text: Health Mission Software delivers a single common DoD+VA electronic health record (MHS GENESIS / DHMSM).
supports: usaspending shows Leidos prime award HT003823F0011 (DHA, $573M) consistent with DHA / DoD health work
scores.interpretation: DHMSM funding is appropriated through the Defense Health Program (DHA O&M) rather than RDT&E or Procurement PEs, so it sits outside the J-Book RDT&E/Procurement corpus by design. USAspending confirms a $573M HT-coded (DHA) award to Leidos — execution corroborated. UNVERIFIABLE within J-Book scope, but the existence of the contract is independently confirmed.

scores.claim_text: Defense Systems segment (13% of fiscal 2025 revenue) serves DoW, Army, Navy, AF, Space Force, USMC, USSOCOM, DARPA, IC.
supports: pentagon_jbook.query_program_funding(contractor_name='Leidos'): NOT_FOUND in entity index, but corpus only attributes 58 entities; absence is not disconfirming
usaspending.query_dod_contracts(recipient_name='Leidos'): n_awards=14,394, total_amount=$9.38B — DoD relationship overwhelmingly confirmed
scores.interpretation: Diversified DoD customer concentration is corroborated at the contract-level. The 13% segment-revenue figure is not load-bearing on any single PE — the company is a services prime with hundreds of millions of dollars in active task orders. PASS on the customer-mix claim.

scores.claim_text: Aerospace Systems delivers space-based EO/IR, hyperspectral, EW/SIGINT, and communications payloads.
supports: pentagon_jbook.query_program_funding(program_name='Tranche 3 Transport Layer'): UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS (PE 1206410SF) — but Leidos is NOT listed as a primary contractor (primaries: York, LMT, NOC)
scores.M_value: NOT_FOUND (no primary attribution); T3 unfunded but not Leidos prime
scores.interpretation: The filing's space-payloads language is generic capability boilerplate, not a load-bearing forward-revenue claim. Heuristic 2 (materiality): the company does not quantify revenue tied to SDA/Tracking Layer programs, and J-Book does not list Leidos as a primary on T3 Transport (UNFUNDED) or Tracking Layer. No divergence detectable from this slice. UNVERIFIABLE.

scores.claim_text: 87% of fiscal 2025 revenue from U.S. government contracts.
supports: Coverage spans DoD, DHA (HT), DISA (HC), etc.

scores.claim_text: Acquired Entrust (KENE) for $2.4B cash on 2026-01-23, with $1.4B bridge facility.
supports: Subjective coherence read: Entrust is a professional engineering / utilities-services firm folded into Commercial & International, which is only 13% of revenue. Strategic fit is OK but not in Leidos's core defense/IT thesis.
Deal funded by $1.4B bridge loan on top of $4.6B existing debt; debt-financed M&A into a non-core segment is a yellow flag per the framework.
scores.interpretation: Cannot run automated coherence scoring; manual read is that the deal is debt-financed and into a non-core (Commercial & International, utilities-engineering) segment while the company is simultaneously announcing a fiscal 2026 segment realignment (Intelligence & Digital / Health / Homeland / Defense — Commercial & International disappears from the segment slate). That sequencing — buying a $2.4B engineering firm to bolt into a segment that the company is restructuring away from — warrants MODERATE_UNDERDELIVERY pending verification. Not a J-Book signal but a rollup-thesis signal.

scores.claim_text: Primary supplier to CBP for non-intrusive inspection systems; 30,000+ scanners deployed across 120+ countries.
supports: usaspending broad query confirms large DoD/federal contract base; specific CBP/DHS line could not be filtered (keyword filter not honored by connector)
Claim is verifiable in principle via federal procurement of NII systems; no contradicting M-source signal
scores.interpretation: Counterparty-disclosure claim with no J-Book exposure. PASS by default; framework has no signal that would impeach it.

Control claim, low materiality. The Huntsville footprint is consistent with Dynetics (Leidos's hypersonics + missile-defense subsidiary), corroborating the Defense Systems narrative. UNVERIFIABLE via M-sources but not impeachable.

summary.jbook_hit_detail: pentagon_jbook returned a non-NOT_FOUND signal only on C6 (Tranche 3 Transport Layer = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS), but Leidos is not a primary contractor on T3 per the corpus, and the filing only mentions space-payload capabilities generically without naming SDA/T3. No actionable J-Book divergence found.
framework_notes: Leidos's 10-K is highly generic — it names broad capability areas (hypersonics, EHR, EO/IR payloads, IFPC, LRPS) without PE numbers, dollar attribution, or forward-deliveries language. Low J-Book attack surface.

Most named programs (IFPC, LRPS, MHS GENESIS, LRHW, CPS) sit in Army procurement / DHA O&M / Navy procurement lines that are outside this corpus's RDT&E/SDA/DARPA/AF focus. Per Heuristic 7, NOT_FOUND is UNVERIFIABLE, not negative.
Only non-J-Book yellow flag: $2.4B debt-financed Entrust acquisition into a segment that is being restructured away in the same period.
